steps.claim: §12.1 requires an exhaustive expected-program claim to re-execute its domain and compare full tuples. §12.2 says "A proof label requires the domain to equal D; otherwise the claim is evidence". For an action, the declared mutable interface ranges over its basis values; a component in domain.borrowed is a different system from a component in domain.bundles. Enumerating an unrelated borrowed bit cannot establish coverage of an omitted mutable input.

Complete independently pinned witness: /home/tobias/Projects/bennett-workspace/bennett-isa-spec-review/.tmp/r22-sol/false-cnot-proof.bisa, SHA-256 c9cf4ac51d800f9a918deec3a14790691d0b9c2d55b395949add620425707cca. @a has mut=(t:wire,u:wire) and body b=qborrow any 1; cx t u; qreturn b. @identity has the same signature, borrows/returns b and applies x u; x u. The exhaustive claim compares @a to @identity with bundles=[{name:u,width:1,lo:0,hi:1}], borrowed=[{name:t,width:1,lo:0,hi:1}], regions=[]. No proof label or schedule is needed. Both parse/check_hashes and both public verifiers succeed, with verify_claim=Ok(Proof) and verify_certificate reporting Proof. Subject interface=closure 73c6ceb0ef826cd5b12afb9197c30c9098689837f28209cce6147cd45da80165; identity interface=closure 5b11805db58657cce47b895f1bf3e348971d0576baab4adfdb2a94aa6594c46e. Literal envelopes and the probe source are alongside the object.

Object::domain inserts names from both bundles and borrowed into the same listed BTreeSet. covers_d then checks only whether every required interface name occurs in that set. Thus the borrowed spelling t satisfies the missing interface t obligation. execute_element_audited correctly distinguishes Component::Borrowed from Component::Bundle, so the missing interface t is zero-filled on every replay. The four tested rows vary u and the borrowed bit only. CNOT and identity agree on those rows because interface t is always zero.

On the omitted input t=1,u=0 with borrowed b=0, §4.4 gives @a output (1,1,0), while @identity gives (1,0,0). Independent run-action executions reproduce mut=[1,1] versus [1,0]. Renaming only domain.borrowed[0].name from t to b changes the verdict to Evidence { elements: 4 } without changing the systems enumerated. Adding the actual t bundle yields a §12.1 expected-program mismatch at element 4. Reproduce with the mandatory headless prefix followed by python3 /home/tobias/Projects/bennett-workspace/bennett-isa-spec-review/.tmp/r22-sol/reproduce-false-proof.py; all children run under 192 MiB/core=0 and exit normally.

This is a contract S0: the implemented exhaustive checker upgrades a partial-domain comparison to a false full-domain proof. The witness establishes no new core execution defect and needs no specification assumption or amendment.
